'''Football Club LNZ Cherkasy''' ({{langx|uk|Футбольний клуб «ЛНЗ» Черкаси}}) is a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] professional [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Cherkasy]]. They currently play in [[Ukrainian Premier League]], the top tier of Ukrainian football. The club is owned by LNZ Group.<ref name=lnzgroup />"}}
